name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
label: Quest
description: Strength of Mount Mugamba: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hail, adventurer. I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will.
Wear this talisman around your neck, adventurer. Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!
